"I don’t know if this will help anyone or not - I was stymied from getting on to the RP realm to roll characters, but I was able to use the following process:

  • Once the rulesets choice becomes available, choose PvE.
  • Choose any of the two styles you wish (Classic is one choice, I think the other reads Modern)
  • At the Character Creation Screen, accept the popup Terms of Service
  • Click Back at the bottom left of the screen
  • Click Rulesets at the top centre of the screen, choose RP (eithe PvE or PvP at your preference)
  • Click to clear any warnings about realms not being available
  • Create your character(s)

I relogged over 3 hours later and my characters were still there (after the 1 hour “emergency” maintenance).

I truly hope this helps someone get in and get their names reserved!
